title: Current Openings
description: We're growing across Myanmar. Explore our open roles and find where you fit.

items.title: National Business Manager
items.summary: Lead our commercial operations and drive sustainable business growth across Myanmar.
responsibilities: Develop and implement national business and sales strategies to achieve company objectives
Recruit and lead the sales team to maximize performance and productivity
Drive sales growth by identifying new business opportunities and strengthening existing customer relationships
Collaborate with the Marketing and Medical teams to ensure successful execution of business plans
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and business performance to identify growth opportunities
Prepare sales forecasts, budgets, and business reports for senior management
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, healthcare professionals, distributors, and business partners
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, Nursing or a related field
Minimum 8-10 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with proven success in a leadership role
Must have prior experience in marketing management and regional management
Excellent communication, negotiation, and people management abilities
Willing to travel nationwide

items.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
items.summary: Oversee product registrations and ensure compliance with Myanmar pharmaceutical regulations.
responsibilities: Manage product registration and renewal processes with regulatory authorities
Prepare and submit regulatory documentation for new and existing products
Monitor changes in pharmaceutical regulations across Myanmar and the region
Advise internal teams on regulatory requirements and compliance obligations
Coordinate with international partners on regulatory submissions
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy or a related scientific field
Minimum 5 years of experience in regulatory affairs within the pharmaceutical industry
Strong knowledge of Myanmar FDA and ASEAN pharmaceutical regulations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Myanmar

items.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
items.summary: Ensure products meet quality standards throughout the distribution process.
responsibilities: Conduct quality audits and inspections across warehouse operations
Manage supplier qualification and documentation processes
Handle product complaints, investigations, and corrective actions
Maintain batch records and product traceability documentation
Support GMP compliance and preparation for regulatory inspections
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in quality assurance in pharmaceutical distribution or manufacturing
Familiarity with GMP, GDP, and ISO quality standards
Detail-oriented with strong documentation and analytical skills

items.title: Warehouse Supervisor
items.summary: Manage daily warehouse operations and ensure efficient product storage and dispatch.
responsibilities: Supervise daily warehouse activities including receiving, storage, and dispatch
Ensure proper inventory management and stock control procedures
Maintain warehouse cleanliness, organization, and cold chain compliance
Coordinate with logistics partners for timely product deliveries
Train and manage warehouse staff on SOPs and safety protocols
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in warehouse or logistics operations
Experience in pharmaceutical or FMCG distribution preferred
Strong organizational and leadership skills

items.title: Medical Representative
items.summary: Promote pharmaceutical products to healthcare professionals and build lasting relationships.
responsibilities: Present pharmaceutical products to doctors, pharmacists, and hospital administrators
Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals in assigned territory
Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets for assigned product portfolio
Collect and report market intelligence, competitor activity, and customer feedback
Attend medical conferences, seminars, and trade events as required
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Science, or a related field
Prior experience in pharmaceutical sales or medical representation preferred
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Willing to travel within assigned territory
Self-motivated with a results-driven approach

items.title: Customer Service Officer
items.summary: Provide product and order support to healthcare customers and ensure satisfaction.
responsibilities: Handle customer inquiries regarding product availability, orders, and documentation
Process orders and coordinate with supply team for timely fulfillment
Manage customer accounts and maintain accurate records in the system
Resolve customer complaints and escalate issues as needed
Prepare reports on customer feedback and service metrics
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field
Minimum 2 years of experience in customer service, preferably in pharmaceutical or healthcare
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems
